code='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    marker_row = h - 1
    marker_cols = [c for c, value in enumerate(grid[marker_row]) if value == 5]
    for c in marker_cols:
        seeds = [(r, grid[r][c]) for r in range(h) if grid[r][c] != 0]
        # Each vertical stripe is segmented by the original marks; each gap
        # takes the color of the mark below it.
        for i, (r, color) in enumerate(seeds):
            upper = seeds[i - 1][0] + 1 if i else 0
            for rr in range(upper, r + 1):
                out[rr][c] = color
        # The bottom marker extends down to the edge (it may be part of seeds).
        bottom = seeds[-1][0]
        for rr in range(bottom, h):
            out[rr][c] = grid[bottom][c]
    return out
'''
